title: Rust RPL serializer hardcodes SCHC version option bytes outside registry owner
description: Rule 7 and versioning correctness rereview: rust lichen-rpl Dio defines SCHC_RULE_VERSION_OPTION as literal 13 01 03 instead of deriving it from lichen-schc SchcRuleVersionOption current and SCHC_RULE_VERSION_TYPE. A future registry increment can update codec compatibility while emitted DIOs silently remain version 3. Remove the duplicate constant, serialize through the canonical SCHC option API, and add a test that the DIO option equals current registry serialization rather than another literal.
